when.expression: #[(vars.incoming.registrationNumber default null) == null or ((vars.incoming.companyName default vars.incoming.name default null) == null)]

set-payload.value: #[{code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: "companyName (or name) and registrationNumber are mandatory"}]

when.expression: #[(vars.registrationIndex default {})[(vars.incoming.registrationNumber as String)] default null != null]

set-payload.value: #[{code: "DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION_NUMBER", message: "A party with this registration number already exists", registrationNumber: vars.incoming.registrationNumber}]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- (vars.registrationIndex default {}) ++ {(vars.incoming.registrationNumber as String): vars.newPartyId}

set-payload.value: #[{code: "PARTY_NOT_FOUND", message: "No party found for id", id: vars.id}]
